title: N2 production by the anammox reaction in the anoxic water column of Golfo Dulce, Costa Rica
summary: Demonstrates that anaerobic ammonium oxidation, rather than conventional denitrification, dominates fixed-nitrogen loss in the anoxic water column of the Golfo Dulce. This is the single most cited piece of work on the gulf and established it as an internationally significant natural laboratory for anoxic nitrogen cycling, directly motivating later interest in the basin's oxygen structure.

data_availability: No deposited dataset; incubation rate measurements are reported in figures and tables within the paper.
